events.description: 수정된 Scene 시각과 실제 렌더 경로 진행률에서 다시 계산한 남은 구면 거리; 압축된 이동 시간은 가정

semantic_visibility.scope: Shared selected-renderer pose, Earth occlusion or projected-map geography, atmospheric handoff visibility, event primitive eligibility and installed-font advance layout at every 30fps pose. No canvas/WebGL, shader brightness, texture visibility, aesthetic assessment or actual rendered-pixel/QC claim.
semantic_visibility.font_layout_policy: Installed OpenSans/Noto glyph advances; whole strings reserve3% for shaping uncertainty. Final browser font/rasterization QC remains required.

narration_alignment.scope: Declared same-Scene event/GIS/claim references and measured or supplied cue intervals; not speech recognition, lexical verification, word alignment, or proof that a named word occurs at an event timestamp

dead_time.automatic_remediation: Scene-local motion timing; story gaps remain blocking until approved plan correction
